mode: UX writing and information hierarchy review; no product code changes

steps.name: Add website
steps.health: Basic task is clear; secondary explanation and technical color details are overly prominent
observations: Visible preview-mode fallback sentence repeats the already visible text icon
Optional name-read button embeds permission mechanics in the label
HEX and reset action occupy the normal adding flow
recommendations: Keep URL, name, icon preview and one primary Add action
Show permission rationale only when optional name completion is initiated
Open advanced color details from the swatch

steps.name: Enhancements
observations: Each toggle repeats its title with a description, implementation-preservation note and enabled status
An additional local-processing paragraph repeats privacy and reversibility information
recommendations: Use compact setting rows with a title, at most one useful sentence and a toggle
Expose infrequent technical help through an accessible help entry

steps.name: Custom storage connection
observations: Several long help paragraphs sit between credentials and actions
Save connection and outer Save settings coexist with different persistence behavior
Settings heading and navigation leave the viewport during the long form
recommendations: Keep the synchronization entry in Enhancements but open connection details separately
Use one primary submission action per form
Keep password recovery limitations, restart-unlock behavior and actual data risks near the relevant action
Keep title and navigation discoverable in long forms

limits: Screenshots are from the current production-file web preview with test navigation data
Native extension authorization and real cloud connections were not exercised
No full accessibility, contrast, assistive-technology or usability study was performed
No connection was saved and no website was added during the audit
